photos.title: Kingston Plantation from above
photos.what: Kingston Plantation from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the oceanfront towers stand along the beach at the bottom right, with the garden buildings, lakes, tennis courts and trees behind them; the Atlantic Ocean fills the lower right corner. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Kingston Plantation from above: the towers on the beach, the garden buildings and lakes behind them.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of Kingston Plantation in Myrtle Beach, labelled: oceanfront towers along the beach, garden buildings among trees and lakes behind them, and the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-d NAIP records (data/2026-11-d/palace-resort/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data
photos.original_size: 2400x1800 NAIP export (the frame itself), labels drawn, then resized to 1600x1200 and 1200x900
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/kingston-plantation/ on 2026-11-14. It shows the oceanfront towers, the garden buildings, lakes, tennis courts and the beach with the Atlantic Ocean. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json). No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of the unlabelled export by tools/photos.js crops, so the share image carries no text.
